result.instructions: Tools for AdminPulse, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which relations have a task with a deadline this week that is not completed?"; "Show the unpaid invoices for APR00001 and their amounts."; "Log a call with a client today at 14:00 with the note I give you.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AdminPulse data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run adminpulse_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run adminpulse_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run adminpulse_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. adminpulse_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: adminpulse_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the connected user
tools.description: Return the AdminPulse user that the API key belongs to (name and email). Good first call to confirm the connection. GET /users/me.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the companies (administrations) that this key can access, with their ids. GET /companies.

tools.name: adminpulse_search_relations
tools.title: Search relations
tools.description: List relations (clients, suppliers and contacts) with paging. Filter by text, relation type (0 company, 1 sole proprietor, 2 person), tags, or include inactive. GET /relations.

searchCriteria.description: Free text: name, code or other searchable field.

type.description: Relation type: 0 company, 1 sole proprietor, 2 person.

withTags.description: Comma-separated tag names; only relations with these tags.

tools.name: adminpulse_get_relation
tools.title: Get a relation
tools.description: Get one relation with its details. Pass the relation GUID or its unique identifier such as APR00001. GET /relations/{identifier}.

identifier.description: Relation GUID or unique identifier, for example APR00001.

tools.name: adminpulse_find_relations_by_name
tools.title: Find relations by name
tools.description: Quick lookup of relations by name, returning a short list with their ids and unique identifiers. GET /relations/names.

searchValue.description: Name or part of a name to find.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices with paging. Filter by relation, invoice date range, or sent, paid, exported and draft status. GET /invoices.

relationIdentifier.description: Relation unique identifier, for example APR00001.

invoiceDateFrom.description: Invoice date from, ddMMyyyy (as the API examples show).

invoiceDateUntil.description: Invoice date until, ddMMyyyy (as the API examples show).

tools.name: adminpulse_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by its id (GUID), with its lines and payment status. GET /invoices/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks with paging. Filter by relation id, deadline range, or main task template. GET /tasks.

deadlineFrom.description: Deadline from (as the API documents it).

deadlineUntil.description: Deadline until (as the API documents it).

languageCode.description: Two-letter language code for task names, for example nl.

tools.name: adminpulse_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Get one task by its id (GUID), with its status, deadline and relation. GET /tasks/{taskId}.

tools.name: adminpulse_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task for a relation. The deadline is ISO, for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00. Status is the number the API defines. POST /tasks.

relationIdentifier.description: Relation unique identifier, for example APR00001.

deadline.description: Deadline in ISO format, for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00.

templateId.description: Task template id (GUID), if the task comes from a template.

status.description: Task status number as the API defines it.

tags.description: Tag names to put on the task.

tools.name: adminpulse_update_task_status
tools.title: Update a task status
tools.description: Set the status of a task found by relation, deadline and task names (no task id needed). Setting the same status again changes nothing. POST /tasks/updateStatus.

relationIdentifier.description: Relation unique identifier, for example APR00001.

deadline.description: Deadline of the task, ddMMyyyy (for example 31122020).

mainTaskName.description: Main task name, for example BTW listing.

subTaskName.description: Sub task name, for example BTW listing opstellen.

status.description: New status number as the API defines it.

inapplicable.description: Mark the task as not applicable.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_interactions
tools.title: List interactions
tools.description: List logged interactions (calls, meetings, notes) with paging. Filter by relation, type or date. GET /interactions.

interactionType.description: Interaction type number as the API defines it.

dateFrom.description: Date from, ddMMyyyy (as the API examples show).

dateUntil.description: Date until, ddMMyyyy (as the API examples show).

tools.name: adminpulse_add_interaction
tools.title: Log an interaction
tools.description: Log an interaction (for example a call or a note) on a relation. The date is ddMMyyyy and the time is HH:mm. POST /interactions/add.

relationIdentifier.description: Relation unique identifier, for example APR00001.

interactiontype.description: Interaction type number as the API defines it.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_registrations
tools.title: List registrations
tools.description: List time or cost registrations with paging. Filter by relation, invoiced state or registration date range. GET /registrations.

relationIdentifier.description: Relation unique identifier, for example APR00001.

invoiced.description: Only invoiced (true) or only not yet invoiced (false) registrations.

tools.name: adminpulse_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List document metadata (name, type, dates, tags) with paging. Filter by relation or document date range. GET /documents.

relationIdentifier.description: Relation unique identifier, for example APR00001.

prompts.title: Get started with AdminPulse
prompts.description: What you can do with AdminPulse here, with example requests to try.
